label: GBIF occurrence count for Brachyura (GBIF backbone key 11132538), 2026-10-31
bibliographic_citation: GBIF.org (2026-10-31) GBIF Occurrence Count API, taxonKey=11132538 (Brachyura). https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/count?taxonKey=11132538
license: Mixed per publishing dataset (CC0 1.0, CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-NC 4.0)

counts.description: occurrence records indexed by GBIF under taxonKey 11132538 (Brachyura, rank infraorder) and all descendants, as returned by the count API

measurement_technique: Aggregated species-occurrence records (preserved specimens, human and machine observations) published to GBIF by its data publishers and interpreted against the GBIF backbone taxonomy; count retrieved with the occurrence/count API.
role: geographic distribution and recording effort for Brachyura

integrity.identifier_note: www.gbif.org landing pages return HTTP 403 to non-browser clients; the API distribution resolved with HTTP 200.

notes: In the GBIF backbone 'Brachyura' is a placeholder taxon ranked FAMILY under Decapoda with no descendants (key 11132538); the count covers only records identified no further than 'Brachyura', not all crabs.
